datasets.summary: FROZEN Dow 30 evaluation bundle for the LAG1 (lagged-snapshot) setting: next-window ADD-flow on 2026-06-23, all 30 constituents x 64 target windows j = 2..65 (dw=300 s, 10:30-16:00 ET). Targets and flow inputs are EQUAL to dow30_valday_flow_2026-06-23 on every shared sample and sample ids are shared by construction (same identity fields + task_version); j=1 is excluded because the prep cache holds no snapshot at boundary 0. Condition refs live in the dow30-lag1 namespace and resolve to the snapshot at boundary j-1 (X_{t-dw}) — a lag0 checkpoint is refused on them. Built straight from the raw LOBSTER message streams via the audited order_flow_histogram_v1 flow engine (closed='left', absolute penny ticks). Immutable (SUCCESS + SHA256SUMS). Built by studies/20260914_lagged_snapshot_lag1; plan docs/plans/20260914_lagged-snapshot-setting.md.
datasets.reference: input window's touch mid: round((max bid tick + min ask tick)/2)
